purpose: Agent-neutral local research proposal contract; not an official grade or executable command source.

candidate_direction.minimum_evidence: A useful distinct question or approach, research rationale, bounded prior-work check and plausible first step.

authority: Candidate experiments cannot modify the effective rubric, evaluator, source manifest or control definition and present it as an unchanged comparison. Such modifications require separate reviewed artifacts.
publication: The participant reviews and explicitly publishes a fork branch/PR; the local harness never publishes or awards itself.
